key_concepts: Earth is the only planet that supports life
Human activities can harm the environment
Cutting trees can cause landslides and floods
Dirty water from homes and factories pollutes rivers and lakes
Garbage in water kills fish and other aquatic animals
Polluted air can cause asthma, allergies, and lung diseases
Soil is important because without soil there is no food
Planting trees helps keep surroundings healthy
Proper garbage disposal helps keep surroundings healthy
Clean streets and canals help keep surroundings healthy
